question: With which vessel should the release of the bali offering be performed?
premises: The verse addresses the goddess as lady of the gods.
It specifies the bali vessel as the instrument.
It prescribes performing the release of the bali offering.
inference: The release of the bali offering should be performed with the bali vessel.
plain_english: O lady of the gods, one should perform the release of the bali offering with the bali vessel.
